theorem binomial_factorial_lower_bound (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) : n ^ 3 ≤ Nat.choose n 1 * Nat.factorial n := by
  have h₁ : n ^ 3 ≤ n * Nat.factorial n := by
    have h₂ : n ^ 2 ≤ Nat.factorial n := by
      
      have h₃ : ∀ k : ℕ, 4 ≤ k → k ^ 2 ≤ Nat.factorial k := by
        intro k hk
        induction' hk with k hk IH
        · norm_num [Nat.factorial]
        · cases k with
          | zero => contradiction
          | succ k =>
            cases k with
            | zero => contradiction
            | succ k =>
              cases k with
              | zero => contradiction
              | succ k =>
                simp_all [Nat.factorial, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.mul_assoc]
                <;> nlinarith
      have h₄ : n ^ 2 ≤ Nat.factorial n := h₃ n hn
      exact h₄
    have h₅ : n * n ^ 2 ≤ n * Nat.factorial n := by
      
      have h₆ : n ^ 2 ≤ Nat.factorial n := h₂
      have h₇ : n * n ^ 2 ≤ n * Nat.factorial n := by
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left n h₆
      exact h₇
    have h₈ : n ^ 3 = n * n ^ 2 := by
      ring
    rw [h₈]
    <;> linarith
  
  have h₂ : n * Nat.factorial n ≤ Nat.choose n 1 * Nat.factorial n := by
    have h₃ : n ≤ Nat.choose n 1 := by
      
      have h₄ : Nat.choose n 1 = n := by
        simp [Nat.choose_one_right]
      rw [h₄]
    have h₅ : n * Nat.factorial n ≤ Nat.choose n 1 * Nat.factorial n := by
      
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right (Nat.factorial n) h₃
    exact h₅
  
  have h₃ : n ^ 3 ≤ Nat.choose n 1 * Nat.factorial n := by
    
    calc
      n ^ 3 ≤ n * Nat.factorial n := h₁
      _ ≤ Nat.choose n 1 * Nat.factorial n := h₂
  
  exact h₃

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem binomial_factorial_lower_bound (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) : n ^ 3 ≤ Nat.choose n 1 * Nat.factorial n := by
  have hfactorial : ∀ m : ℕ, 4 ≤ m → m ^ 2 ≤ Nat.factorial m := by
    intro m hm
    induction m, hm using Nat.le_induction with
    | base =>
        norm_num [Nat.factorial]
    | succ m hm ih =>
        rw [Nat.factorial_succ]
        have hsmall : m + 1 ≤ m ^ 2 := by
          nlinarith
        calc
          (m + 1) ^ 2 = (m + 1) * (m + 1) := by ring
          _ ≤ (m + 1) * m ^ 2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hsmall
          _ ≤ (m + 1) * Nat.factorial m := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ih
  
  calc
    n ^ 3 = n * n ^ 2 := by ring
    _ ≤ n * Nat.factorial n := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (hfactorial n hn)
    _ = Nat.choose n 1 * Nat.factorial n := by simp

      (P := fun m _ => m ^ 2 ≤ Nat.factorial m) ?_ ?_ m hm
